$comment: Advisories accepted by scripts/audit.mjs. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry date; once expired the audit fails again, so the exception gets re-reviewed instead of lingering.

advisories.reason: ReDoS needs an attacker-supplied glob pattern. picomatch only gets patterns from our own config (ESLint, Vitest, next-intl's file watcher at dev/build time), never from request data. No patched version exists yet (latest is 4.0.7).
